newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish parliament approves law to register gold.
newsitem.headline: Turkish parliament approves law to register gold.

text.p: Turkey's parliament approved a draft law on Wednesday which will allow jewellers to declare their unregistered physical inventories of precious metals.
According to the law, jewellers will not face any punishment for their unregistered stocks if they declare them within one month from the publication of the law in the official gazette.
They will pay a six-percent tax on gold bullion and seven percent on other precious metals.
The law is part of the government's revenue-raising package unveiled in September. It hopes to raise 64 trillion lira through the plan.
Officials said 700 tonnes of precious metals were expected to be declared under the law.
